subject: general
question: Convert 8.5% into a decimal.
solution:
The correct answer is __0.085.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Percentages__ can be converted into decimals by dividing them by 100.
 
• For 8.5%, divide 8.5 by 100.&l
